```{r instalar_referencia, eval=FALSE}
BiocManager::install("scRNAseq", update = FALSE, ask = FALSE)
```

```{r cargar_referencia}
library(scRNAseq)

# Referencia de mesencéfalo embrionario de ratón
sce_ref <- LaMannoBrainData("mouse-embryo", ensembl = FALSE, location = FALSE)
sce_ref <- sce_ref[, !is.na(sce_ref$Cell_type)]
rownames(sce_ref) <- make.unique(rownames(sce_ref))

referencia <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = as(assay(sce_ref, "counts"), "dgCMatrix"),
                                 project = "LaManno")
referencia$cell_type <- as.character(sce_ref$Cell_type)
table(referencia$cell_type)
```
